title: Governed forward-validation deployment configuration
description: The contract for /etc/workbench/forward_validation.json. This schema is SOURCE-CONTROLLED and describes shape and defaults only. The installed file is a DEPLOYMENT value: it names paths on the host and is never committed, because committing it would duplicate governed artifacts into the repository and invite a copy to drift from the artifact it names. Every path here points AT an installed artifact; none of them is a repository path.

factor_store_path.description: The governed corpus (immutable base plus applied deltas) on the host.

app_db_path.description: Application DB, read-only, for the Account-4 isolation probe.

observation_store_dir.description: Root of the committed observation chain.

dgs3mo_path.description: The FROZEN DGS3MO base, installed by exact hash (DGS3MO_SNAPSHOT_SHA256). Never regenerated: a normalized, reordered or reserialized copy is a different artifact and the preflight refuses it.

trial_ledger_path.description: The FROZEN governed trial ledger, installed by exact hash (TRIAL_LEDGER_SHA256), N=45. Synthesizing an empty ledger to satisfy configuration loading is prohibited — EFFECTIVE_DSR_TRIAL_COUNT is read from this file and an empty one silently changes the DSR gate's severity.

build_info_path.description: GENERATED by scripts/generate_deployment_evidence.py. Records the exact merged commit, tree cleanliness, interpreter and dependency versions, application package hash and frozen Stage-2/3/4 replica hashes.

deployment_manifest_path.description: GENERATED. Binds the whole session deployment, including the `corpus` identity block (ADR 0048 §8).

corpus_manifest_path.description: The governed corpus construction. Either an immutable base plus ORDERED append-only deltas, each hashed and countersigned (ADR 0048), or a `layer2_governed_corpus` whole-corpus reconstruction, which carries no base and no delta chain.

corpus_countersignature_path.description: The external countersignature sidecar. REQUIRED for a `layer2_governed_corpus` construction and refused-if-absent at composition; a reconstruction is never composed on the strength of the construction artifact alone. Not used by the base-plus-delta construction, whose approval travels with each delta.

dgs3mo_manifest_path.description: The risk-free construction: the frozen DGS3MO base plus ordered, separately hashed extensions through the observation cutoff (ADR 0048 §10-11).

runtime_digest_path.description: Required for CONTAINER unless runtime_digest_env is set.

expected_commit.description: Operator PIN. Narrows the derived identity; never becomes it.

ledger_account_id.description: The shadow / separate paper account. Account 4 is refused at config load: the forward validation never runs on the live book.

starting_capital.description: Governed. Never the retired 84466.41 baseline and never Account-4 capital.

turnover_cost_bps.description: The registered cost. The shadow ledger accounts at this rate only.

witness.description: The anchor trust boundary (ADR 0045/0046/0047). Required: a deployment that cannot independently witness its chain tips cannot run a governed session.

key_id.description: The FULL immutable KMS key ARN. Aliases and bare key ids are refused.

public_key_path.description: The deployment-installed DER SPKI trust root.

trusted_root.description: Governed directory the key-path walk starts from.
